chunks: By this chain of narration, he said: Al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) would frequently say:

The knowledge of the clear path is evident for him who seeks it, but I see the hearts are blinded from the clear path. I am astonished at the one who perishes while his salvation is present, and I am astonished at the one who is saved.

key_terms.المحجة: Al-Mahajja — the clear, wide path; metaphor for the path of truth and guidance
key_terms.عمى: Blindness — spiritual blindness of the heart, not physical

ai.seo_question: What did Imam al-Sadiq say about the clear path and spiritual blindness?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) frequently recited this poetic verse expressing wonder at the paradox of human guidance. The path of truth (al-mahajja) is clear and available, yet many hearts remain blind to it. The Imam marvels both at those who perish despite salvation being accessible, and at the rarity of those who find their way. In the original context, 'al-mahajja' referred to the clear path of the Ahlulbayt's teachings, which the Imam's followers recognized as the authentic continuation of prophetic guidance.
